gate.description: The waivable gate or budget the request names.

policy.description: The remediation unit that filed it.

evidence_uri.description: pm://plan/{plan_id}/evidence/{evidence_id} of the failure the request is about.

outcome.description: null while pending; declined by the operator's decline; cancelled when the plan ends while the request is pending (cancel, abandon, the release of its project, the integrity abort, delete-plan).

answered.description: waived, raised, or declined: the operator's act that answered the request; null otherwise.

reason.description: declined: the operator's reason, when given.

pr_comment_ref.description: Provider id of the idempotent request comment (label pm-mcp:waiver-requested).
